subject: Taxes
title: The Stateless Income Problem
description: One-minute skill: The Stateless Income Problem.

hook.text: Some corporate income is legally taxed nowhere. It exists in a gap between countries' tax systems.

buildup.text: The Stateless Income Problem sets up the core claim, the assumptions, and the stakes.

discovery.text: The Stateless Income Problem reveals the mechanism or argument that changes the picture.

twist.text: These companies aren't breaking laws. They exploit tax rules designed for a physical economy, not a digital one.

climax.text: Stateless income is the ultimate tax planning achievement: profit that exists but technically belongs nowhere.

punchline.text: Earned somewhere. Taxed nowhere. Stateless income is a legal phantom.

quiz.question: What is 'stateless income'?
options: Corporate income that falls through gaps between countries' tax systems
